description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Customer_4</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AppointmentReceived" messageRef="Message_Appointment"/>

    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_3" sourceRef="Task_SendServiceRequest" targetRef="Event_AppointmentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Customer_4" sourceRef="Event_AppointmentReceived" targetRef="Event_TechnicianArrived"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_CentralService" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Facility_7</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive confirmation that the fridge is OK" messageRef="Message_Confirmation">

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FacilityRepaired" name="Repair confirmed">

    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceFacility" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Event_AppointmentSent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_6" name="No additional parts are needed" sourceRef="Gateway_PartsNeeded" targetRef="Task_RepairFridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_7" sourceRef="Event_UnableToRepair" targetRef="End_FacilityNoRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_8" sourceRef="Task_RepairFridge" targetRef="Event_RepairComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_9" sourceRef="Event_RepairComplete" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Facility_10" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_FacilityRepaired"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
